mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Counterattack1.det: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> Recently, jumps in quasimorphosis have been recorded at %STATION_NAME%. This is not stated directly, but our analysts have long learned to recognize the corresponding hints in the <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color>. Apparently, this activity attracted %VICTIM_NAME% here. They have captured part of the station and are preparing to hold some kind of <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> there. We must not let them finish what they started. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% promises a worthy reward.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Counterattack1.obj: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the group of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% before the <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> is completed.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Defense1.after: The reward from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already on Magnum. If we can hold off even %VICTIM_NAME%, does that mean we can destroy them? Or is it just the euphoria of successfully completing a mission?
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Defense1.briefing: As soon as we get you there, the attack will begin. Sensors show that quasimorphs have already appeared in certain places of %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold out as long as possible</color>, their onslaught will certainly weaken.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Defense1.details:
Details: Due to an information quarantine blocking any reports of quasimorphosis, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is unable to directly report that %STATION_NAME% is about to be attacked by %VICTIM_NAME%.

Quasimorphs not only know how to linger in physical reality, but also have learned to bypass the SBN filters. They constantly transmit messages to the network. The Hexarchy immediately declares them fakes of the Civil Resistance.

If we want a reward from %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, then we should hurry.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Elimination1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% asked us to provide us with a report on the events that accompanied the completion of tasks. A lot of effort went into preparing it. Perhaps it was more difficult than killing that quasimorph? Let's hope the reward in Magnum's cargo bay was worth the pain.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Elimination1.brief: The sensors are almost completely blind: we observe unimaginable leaps of quasimorphosis. We'll drop you off wherever we can. <color=#FFFEC1>Eliminate the Duke</color>. Don't try to be a hero and clear out the entire %STATION_NAME%, it's not in the contract.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Elimination1.detai:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has launched activities around %STATION_NAME%. It wants to get this asset, but, judging by the analysis of data from the SBN, not yet ready for direct actions. The corporatists can be understood: %STATION_NAME% is in the clutches of %VICTIM_NAME%, which has openly challenged the human world order. These quasimorphs have somehow learned to linger in our reality for a long time. We can test the strength of their defenses.

It is known from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% that a quasimorph of the duke type was spotted at %STATION_NAME%. If we manage to eliminate it, then the forces of %VICTIM_NAME% here will be significantly weakened. Of course, we are not doing this to save humanity. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% indicated that PMC, which takes on this work, will receive a good reward.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Escort1.after: As a reward for saving a valuable employee, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% sent us a package so that we could conduct field tests. There are some of its new products. The cargo is already on board Magnum.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Escort1.briefing: The target signature provided to us by %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is clearly visible. <color=#FFFEC1>Escort the security officer to the specified location</color> at %STATION_NAME%. The attackers are <color=#FFFEC1>quasimorphs</color>, so be extremely careful. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but if you see something important, act according to the circumstances.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the security officer of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Escort1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> The headquarters of the security officer of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is located at %STATION_NAME%. Recently, they have carried out several successful operations against quasimorphs. And now %VICTIM_NAME% is about to attack the station. If we take on this fixed-term contract, we will need to <color=#FFFEC1>bring the Security Service officer to the safe location</color>.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Escort1.objective0: New day, new quasimorphs. <color=#FFFEC1>Your task</color>: escort the Security Service officer to the safe location. Perhaps it is this person who will later lead the resistance when %VICTIM_NAME% becomes a problem.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Espionage1.after: The meeting with a representative of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. It's a good deal: a worthless rock in exchange for valuable cargo.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Espionage1.briefin:
The signature of igvalite has been found, its location is marked on your map. Move through %STATION_NAME% carefully, save your strength. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is ready to reward well for this rock.

We will try to drop you off as close to the place as possible, but we cannot promise anything: the shuttle pilot reports strange visions.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Espionage1.details:
Details: Despite the suppression of information by the Hexarchy, it is known that %STATION_NAME% is in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% discovered something interesting there.

A reconnaissance drone sent there picked up the signature of an igvalite, a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It appears that %VICTIM_NAME% is using this station for energy storage. We have work to do.

%BENEFICIARY_NAME% offers a job to infiltrate %STATION_NAME% and pick up the igvalite.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Espionage1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> - a quasimorphic artifact similar to a mineral, and then return with it to Magnum. Stealing is included in the standard range of our services. The fact that we are operating in the territory of quasimorphs does not change anything.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_RaiderCapture1.aft: As expected, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% claimed %STATION_NAME% as their property. What happened there is a corporate secret. We got what we were due: the cargo from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already on Magnum.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_RaiderCapture1.bri:
We don't know why exactly these quasimorphs remain in our reality. As a rule, the quasimorphosis subsides soon after the violence stops. But %VICTIM_NAME% has learned to overcome this limitation. You'll have to work manually.

After disembarking, methodically move forward through %STATION_NAME% and shoot everything that moves. Keep your eyes open and try to be prepared for any turn of events. Good luck.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_RaiderCapture1.des: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate <color=#FFFEC1>50% of the quasimorphs</color> living on %STATION_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_RaiderCapture1.det:
Details: Quasimorphosis is gradually ceasing to be a mystery. The Hexarchy is trying to maintain the appearance of control: everything unusual is presented as provocations of the Civil Resistance. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% sent a notification via the SBN that it was going to conduct an orphan asset inspection. In other words, it is ready to attract PMC to take %STATION_NAME% away from the quasimorphs. After our victory, it will declare what happened as its contribution to the restoration of order in the System. Let it say what it want, the main thing is that it will have to invest heavily in us.

Here's what you need to do: walk around %STATION_NAME% and kill as many quasimorphs as possible. Somehow, %VICTIM_NAME% was able to train quasimorphs to linger in physical reality for a long time.

When we leave this place, the smart guys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will arrive and put %STATION_NAME% in order.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_RaiderCapture1.obj: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate <color=#FFFEC1>50% of the quasimorphs</color> living on %STATION_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Sabotage1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is extremely grateful for your assistance in... studying %STATION_NAME%. The cargo is already on board Magnum.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Sabotage1.briefing: These <color=#FFFEC1>reliquaries</color>... they light up our sensors. Finding and destroying them is a very good idea. Be extremely careful: %STATION_NAME% is literally crawling with quasimorphs. Stay focused on the objective and do not allow yourself to be distracted. At any moment, the situation can only deteriorate.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Sabotage1.details:
Details: The Hexarchy, via SBN, reports that the proceedings concerning the unusual events in the Solar System are still ongoing. However, corporations are unwilling to wait for official authorization, and an increasing number of assets in the Inner System are becoming “orphaned.” No one officially acknowledges the existence of quasimorphs. Assets currently controlled by %VICTIM_NAME% can therefore be appropriated. As a result, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has a strong interest in %STATION_NAME%, but is not prepared for direct actions.

According to their information, this location contains one or more objects resembling statues or obelisks. The artifact is unquestionably of quasimorphic origin. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% refers to it as a reliquary and is willing to pay handsomely for its destruction.

We believe that these reliquaries are connected to the ability of quasimorphs to maintain a prolonged presence in physical reality.
mission.Corp_Tezctlan_Sabotage1.objectiv: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and destroy the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquaries</color> — quasimorphic artifacts resembling obelisks.
mission.Corp_Xiomara_Control1.after: The meeting with representatives of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. The reward was transferred to Magnum. We were the only ones who responded when it became clear that the attackers were <color=#FFFEC1>quasimorphs</color>.
mission.Corp_Xiomara_Control1.briefing: <color=#FFFEC1>Quasimorphs</color> of %VICTIM_NAME% are already attacking %STATION_NAME%. Methodically kill them, <color=#FFFEC1>don’t let them break</color> the communication equipment.
mission.Corp_Xiomara_Control1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %VICTIM_NAME% is preparing an attack in this part of the Solar System. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is trying in any way to retain %STATION_NAME%. The quasimorphs seem to be targeting the <color=#FFFEC1>communications equipment</color>. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be extremely grateful to us if we stop them.
mission.Corp_Xiomara_Control1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Protect the communications equipment of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. It is a satellite dish aimed into space.
mission.Corp_Xiomara_Counterattack1.afte: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has already transferred the reward to Magnum. I can’t shake the feeling that it was watching what was happening at the station and collecting information. Do you feel like a laboratory mouse, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>?
mission.Corp_Xiomara_Counterattack1.brie: It will not be possible to drop you off close to the ritual site. A real war has been going on at %STATION_NAME% for several days. We'll have to hurry. Quasimorphs must be stopped!

mission.evacuation_allowed: Good job. Go back to the <color=#FFFEC1>elevator</color>, and we'll pick you up.
mission.evacuation_allowed_defense: Good work, soldier. Get back to the shuttle.
mission.evacuation_failed: Evacuation denied until the <color=#FFFEC1>mission</color> objective is completed.
mission.evacuation_failed_baron: The space around the location is unstable. <color=#FFFEC1>Evacuation is not possible</color> at this time.
mission.evacuation_flee: Well, better luck next time. At least we saved the biomaterial.
